items.description: Copper pipe repair - fittings, pipe section, consumables
items.rationale: Fracture damage to heating pipe inside building covered under 2.4.3(a); materials per 7.1.7(c). Fair price for about 1 m copper pipe plus fittings and consumables.
Labour at customary rates under 7.1.7(g); 1.5 days seems long for a 1 m pipe repair, so only the necessary hours (about 8-10 technician hours plus some helper time) are allowed.
Insulation forming part of the component is covered under 7.1.7(c), but only about 1 m was repaired; 6 pcs exceeds the documented repair (7.1.8(e)), so only around 1-2 pcs are allowed.
One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f); this is the only one.
Disposal of affected components under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1; a small bag of old pipe and insulation, so a modest amount.
General administrative/processing charge is excluded under 7.1.8(b).

items.description: Tile cleaning, disinfection and coating, 5 hrs
items.rationale: Combined line mixing cleaning/upkeep with coating, which is an improvement not present before; excluded under 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.9. Tiles were not physically damaged (7.1.5).
